question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping faces no apparent challenge to his leadership ahead of the 21st Communist Party Congress expected in late 2027. At age 73, he has given no public signal of intent to step aside, and analysts view ongoing military and party purges—tied to his long-running anti-corruption campaign—as tools for consolidating authority rather than evidence of weakening control. The 20th Central Committee has seen substantial turnover through expulsions, yet surviving leadership structures remain aligned with his priorities. No credible reports indicate health-related incapacity or organized opposition capable of forcing an early exit before 2027. These factors underpin trader consensus reflected in the 95% implied probability that Xi will remain in his core posts through the end of 2026.
